[i]Ever on the move while learning, growing, changing, and experiencing all that life has to offer.[/i]
 
Kristine Brown is the World☆Class Voyager. Cheery, bombastic, and wide-ranging with a friendly and positive-minded personality, she is a curious, confident, happy-go-lucky adventurer and new experience-seeker. Kristine is a queer woman who has idolized adventurous characters (both real and imaginary) from early childhood. Kristine’s fame spreads via word-of-mouth from her many friends residing in every corner of the globe, and her huge heart always has room to welcome in even more.

Likes: Travel, boating, puzzles, conversation
Dislikes: Being alone, staying in one place, enclosed (especially confined) spaces
